text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day, and while the 
academy is enveloped in a joyful 
atmosphere—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew... This day always makes me feel a 
little sentimental...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was a tragic affair... At last 
year's chocolate exchange—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I put so much effort into preparing gifts 
to make my juniors happy, and yet..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And then she declared... "It's the trendy 
fresh ganache chocolate!" just like that!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Everyone seemed pleased, but I only found 
out later... that the trend had come and 
gone ages ago.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"It's not fine! I just wanted everyone to 
experience the latest trend!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"To think that I, someone who's always 
keeping an eye on trends, would make such 
a blunder..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not just with what we were just talking 
about, but I do feel out of the loop with 
current trends here and there...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So with that said, I've had enough of 
feeling sad, so there's no chocolate for 
you, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So with that said, I've had enough of 
feeling sad, so there's no chocolate for 
you, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Too bad?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu! Just kidding, psych♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Since you always look out for me, I'm 
going to make sure I get you a proper 
present."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, I'll give you some chocolate, 
so will you come with me?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, I was put into a car to 
receive chocolates, and the destination we 
arrived at was—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Alright, we're here!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Look, there are so many shops here! Go 
ahead and pick out whatever chocolate 
you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“If I have you pick for me, Trainer-kun, I 
won't have to worry about trends, right?”
choice_data_list:
I have to pick out my own chocolate 
myself?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“If I have you pick for me, Trainer-chan, 
I won't have to worry about trends, 
right?”
choice_data_list:
I have to pick out my own chocolate 
myself?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, don't worry about 
it! It feels just like we're shopping 
together, so it's fun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't be shy, take whatever you 
like♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I thoroughly enjoyed picking out 
chocolates for myself together with 
Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, this isn't just any 
ordinary chocolate. After all, it's 
handmade!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
See, that way you don't have to worry 
about trends, and you can also pour your 
feelings of gratitude into it, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My heart was just fluttering while making 
it♪ Wondering if you'd like it and all, 
you know!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, you're very welcome!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...So, where might your shoe locker be, 
Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...So, where might your shoe locker be, 
Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on, when it comes to giving 
chocolates, putting them in the shoe 
locker is standard practice, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I made sure it's the right size for the 
shoe locker~ Now, won't you tell me which 
one is yours?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though the way it was handed over felt 
somewhat dated, I gratefully accepted it 
afterwards.
